DeliveryRefundUpdate.description: Reports the final decision regarding a submitted delivery refund request to clients via webhook.

delivery_id.description: The UUID associated with the delivery.

accepted.description: Whether the refund was accepted or not.

reason.description: The reason for accepting or rejecting the refund.

description.description: Additional descriptive notes about the refund decision.
description.example: Grubhub accepts the full refund amount.

RefundAmount.description: The amount of the refund requested, broken down into various categories.

delivery_fee.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the delivery fee, formatted as cents.

tip.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the tip, formatted as cents.

contents_value.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the contents value, formatted as cents.

return_fee.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the return fee, formatted as cents.

Assigned.description: An event indicating the delivery has been assigned.

source.description: Types of actors who may update a delivery.

reason_code.description: Codes for reasons why a delivery was canceled.

Canceled.description: An event indicating that the delivery was canceled.

ClientData.description: Partner/client-supplied reference identifiers for this delivery.

external_id.description: The partner's own identifier for this delivery.

external_merchant_id.description: The partner's identifier for the merchant associated with this delivery.

external_source.description: The source system that supplied the external identifiers.

reference_number.description: A partner-supplied reference number for this delivery.

name.description: The display name of the courier assigned to a delivery.

delivery_method.description: Means of transportation by which a courier may be delivering.

CourierAtDropoff.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has arrived at the delivery's dropoff location.

CourierAtPickup.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has arrived at the delivery's pickup location.

Created.description: An event representing the creation of a delivery.

Delivered.description: An event indicating the delivery has been successfully delivered.

Delivery.description: The information and historical events associated with a delivery.

delivery_id.description: A unique identifier of this delivery.

events.description: A history of notable events that have occurred for this delivery.

DeliveryEvent.description: An event during the course of a single delivery's lifecycle.

timestamp.description: The time at which this event occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

DeliveryStatusUpdate.description: Provides information about the status of a delivery and the courier assigned to it, pushed to clients via webhook.

tracking_url.description: The url for the delivery tracking UI.

photo_url.description: A URL to the dropoff photo taken by the driver upon completing the delivery.

photo_capture_time.description: The timestamp at which the dropoff photo was captured. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

photo_expiration_time.description: The timestamp when the dropoff photo will expire.

EstimatedEventTimes.description: The latest known estimates for the delivery pickup and dropoff times. Will be the actual times if the event has already occurred.

picked_up.description: The estimated pickup time, or the actual pickup time if the pickup has already occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

dropped_off.description: The estimated drop-off time, or the actual drop-off time if the pickup has already occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

GeoLocation.description: The last known location of the courier.

InTransit.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has departed the restaurant with the delivery.

PickedUp.description: An event indicating the delivery has been picked up by the assigned courier.

PickupVerification.description: An event containing pickup verification information.

result.description: The result of the pickup verification.

capture_method.description: The method used to capture the pickup verification.

failure_reason.description: The reason for a failed pickup verification. Null when result is SUCCESS.

attempts_count.description: The total number of verification attempts made.

photo_url.description: A URL to the pickup verification photo. Null for code-match events.

ProofOfDelivery.description: An event containing proof of delivery information.

ReturnCompleted.description: An event indicating that the necessary portion of the delivery's contents have been successfully returned to the pickup location.

ReturnInitiated.description: An event indicating the delivery is in-transit back to the pickup location in order to return some portion of the delivery's contents.

Unassigned.description: An event indicating the delivery has been unassigned. An unassigned delivery may still be reassigned to another driver later.
